insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room rent eligibility is specified in the Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; proportionate deduction applies if higher room is taken. No specific cap stated in wording.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under inpatient care; specific limit/cap not stated in wording, deferred to Policy Schedule.

copayment.note: Co-payment percentage is specified in the Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; not applicable on maternity, ambulance, air ambulance, health check-up unless specified.

sub_limits.note: Sub-limits for modern treatments and other benefits are specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; specific disease sub-limits not enumerated in wording.

deductible.note: Annual Aggregate Deductible is optional and specified in Policy Schedule; not applicable on maternity, ambulance, air ambulance, health check-up.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses from first policy commencement; waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period in months is specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance; wording does not state a fixed number.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specific disease waiting period in months is specified in Policy Schedule; list includes cataract, hernia, osteoarthritis, spinal disorders, etc.

maternity.display: Covered (waiting period as per Policy Schedule)
maternity.note: Covered for normal delivery, C-section, complicated pregnancy; available if female insured is 18+; claimable max twice lifetime; waiting period specified in Policy Schedule; Re-Fill not available for maternity unless specified.

cumulative_bonus.note: No Claim Bonus added each claim-free year at rate specified in Policy Schedule; max accumulation 200% of Base Sum Insured.

restoration.note: ReAssure benefit: once Base SI + Loyalty Credit + NCB exhausted, unlimited restoration triggered; max single claim under ReAssure is 200% of Base SI or as per Policy Schedule; available for inpatient, day care, alternative treatments, critical illness multiplier.

pre_hosp.note: Number of pre-hospitalisation days covered is specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance.

post_hosp.note: Number of post-hospitalisation days covered is specified in Policy Schedule/Certificate of Insurance.

day_care.note: Option 1: any procedure >2 hrs and <24 hrs covered. Option 2: specific list of 536+ procedures. Applicable option stated in Policy Schedule.

domiciliary.note: Covered for medically necessary treatment at home when patient cannot be moved or hospital room unavailable; minimum 3 consecutive days unless waived in Policy Schedule.

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered for inpatient care in NABH/NQAS accredited AYUSH hospitals; Yoga and Naturopathy excluded unless specifically mentioned in Policy Schedule.

organ_donor.note: Covers living donor's inpatient hospitalisation expenses for organ harvesting; excludes stem cell donation (except bone marrow), pre/post-hosp of donor, screening costs.

ambulance.note: Emergency ground ambulance covered at reasonable & customary charges for network providers; non-network capped at amount in Policy Schedule. Air ambulance also covered. One transfer per hospitalisation.

modern_treatments.note: Modern treatments covered as inpatient or day care; list in Annexure IV; sub-limits if any specified in Policy Schedule.

consumables.note: Standard non-medical consumables (gloves, masks, etc.) are listed as non-payable in Annexure II. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India excluded by default; coverage available only if Option 2 or 3 of Inpatient Care is specifically opted and mentioned in Policy Schedule.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration credits), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for annual/half-yearly/quarterly premium; 15 days for monthly instalment premium.

free_look.note: 30-day free look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable on new policies, not renewals.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI norms; credits for PED waiting, specific waiting periods, NCB, moratorium transferable.

notable_exclusions: Hormone replacement therapy, sleep disorders, STIs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, circumcision (non-medical), multifocal lens, ambulatory devices, animal bite (unless opted)
optional_riders: Hospital Cash Benefit, ICU Cash, OPD cover (video/tele/physical consultations, diagnostics, pharmacy), Accidental Cover, Critical Illness Cover, Critical Illness Multiplier Indemnity, Income Protector, EMI Cover, Air Ambulance, Health Check-up, Second Medical Opinion, Empathy Benefit
